note: Swift/SwiftUI repo — outside the converter envelope (no JS build, no Storybook). The Claude Design project is a hand-authored web mirror of the SwiftUI design system; it is maintained by reading the Swift sources directly. Source of truth is the CODE (Packages/GanchoKit/Sources/GanchoDesign + Apps/*).
stagingDir: scratchpad (not committed) — the project has no local mirror by design
uploadPath: atomic (pre-existing non-empty project, re-adopted from the URL the owner pasted)
anchor: none — _ds_sync.json is deliberately omitted: the converter's hash recipe assumes a JS dist/ or a Storybook, neither of which exists here. Every sync re-reads the Swift sources, which is correct for this repo.
rules: The CODE wins. Where the design system and the shipped app disagree, update the DS and document the divergence (see guidelines/color-kinds.card.html).
Only capitalized exports reach window.GanchoDesignSystem_a31491; lowercase helpers must be inlined in a card.
_ds_bundle.js recompiles at the TURN BOUNDARY — a card using a brand-new component renders blank until then.
Card CDN <script> tags carry integrity hashes; copy them verbatim from an existing card.
Never transition a var() background on a segmented control (stale composited layer).
